Any target who has M < 2 is also [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (save ends). > ⭐️ **Petrifying Fumes** > > Any creature who starts their turn adjacent to the tonguesnapper and has M < 1 is [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed) (save ends).
